fact: The Observatoire de la qualité des services financiers, under the Ministry of Finance since 2009, handled 475 new disputed files in 2025 (379 in 2024) through mediation, 357 of them banking, microfinance, financial institutions and La Poste.

The OQSF reports 475 new disputed files handled through mediation in 2025, against 379 in 2024: 357 in banking, microfinance, financial institutions and La Poste and 118 in insurance, the main banking grounds being slow international transfers (25.4%) and credit repayment difficulties (17%).

The executive secretary of Senegal's Observatoire de la Qualité des Services Financiers (OQSF) writes that mobile money users can seek redress from a third party such as the OQSF when a provider does not resolve a problem; in its 2022 survey with CGAP only 1% did.
